status: approved retrospective protocol; hybrid observation clarification approved by maintainer; frozen before comparative outcomes

development.status: previously examined exploratory cohort; not independent validation

A.condition: original counter > original T at original checks

C.condition: B AND latest original counter > T at saved classification times; no eligibility latch

sensitivity.selection: report all cells, no best-cell or per-dataset tuning

schedules.B_C: primary: decisions only at positive multiples of 1000; sum every published transition in the window, including legacy-event observations; hybrid, not exclusively periodic monitoring
schedules.C_counter: latest original check at or before observation; age <=9
schedules.window_start_B_C: latest actual saved observation at or before decision-window; require it to exist; count each subsequent observed transition once in temporal order, including intermediates; report actual span
schedules.window_D: stop-window < check <= stop; require full history
schedules.B_C_secondary: secondary: decisions at all published classification observations, same transition sum and parameters

classification_denominator: initially unlabeled nodes; transitions count multiplicity, not distinct nodes
accuracy: exact timestamp match only; otherwise missing; no interpolation or claimed bracket bounds
timing: archive supports iteration savings, not real prefix timings, overhead or speedups
censoring: retain all cases; right censor at cap; no invented stop time
freeze_gate: protocol commit and normalized SHA-256 registered before any archive candidate evaluation
D_interpretation: cumulative historical-best gains measure record stagnation, not general dominance stability
approved_scope: retrospective comparison only; no new trajectories, tuning, API, kernel or default changes
